rounds.text: Optimus Finance Ltd is significantly undervalued relative to its peers, trading at a P/E of 9.31x against a sector benchmark of 19.64x [E6], while delivering a superior ROA of 4.89% compared to the sector benchmark of 1.86% [E8]. This valuation discount ignores a strong long-term track record, highlighted by a 10-year compounded profit growth of 34% [E18], a 5-year compounded profit growth of 24% [E19], and a median sales growth of 43.0% over the last 10 years [E54]. Conceded: the company's dividend yield is 0.00% [E4], trailing twelve-month profit growth is -2% [E21], and its earnings growth is currently decelerating [E62]. However, with a price-to-book ratio of 1.34x [E2] which sits below the sector benchmark of 1.35x [E7], the market is overly discounting a historically high-performing business.

blind_spot_facts.fact: Compounded profit growth over 3 years is 8%.
